summary: Iteration 51 - Email/Password auth + Google regression - ALL GREEN. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed (register happy path with default lang=en, duplicate 409, short-password 422, >72 UTF-8 bytes 422, login correct + case-insensitive, wrong-pw generic 401, unknown-email SAME generic 401 body ('Incorrect email or password'), session_token→/auth/me→/auth/logout revocation, bogus Google session_id 401, dev-bypass founder 200). Frontend E2E on /login (mobile viewport 390×844): all testIDs present (pw-tab-login, pw-tab-register, pw-email, pw-password, pw-eye, pw-submit, google-signin-button, founder-bypass-btn); SIGN IN with demo.judge@guardian.app / guardian-demo-2026 lands user → TOS gate → tos-gate-accept → standard-home; wrong password shows 'Incorrect email or password.' via login-err; CREATE ACCOUNT with short pw shows 'Password must be at least 12 characters.'; CREATE ACCOUNT with fresh email + 12-char pw registers → lands on ENGLISH TOS gate ('TERMS OF SERVICE · v2026-06.1'), confirming models.py default language='en' for new users works. No password_hash leaked in any response.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated - use 'boxShadow'; 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated - use 'textShadow'; props.pointerEvents is deprecated - use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking but should be migrated across app styles.

action_items: Optional: pre-existing demo.judge account still has language='sk' (created before the sk→en default change) so TOS gate/home render in Slovak for it. Fresh registrations correctly get English. If English is desired for the demo account too, main agent can PATCH /api/me/prefs {language:'en'} for demo.judge or re-seed it.
Optional cleanup: migrate deprecated style props (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents) to modern equivalents to silence RN Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: password_hash is properly stripped from all responses (register + login). bcrypt 12 rounds via run_in_threadpool - good. Timing-safe dummy hash check for unknown emails prevents enumeration - verified via identical 401 body.
Register endpoint casefolds email before uniqueness check and _provision_user also lowercases - consistent.
Pydantic Field(min_length=12, max_length=72) on RegisterIn handles char-length; explicit _validate_password_bytes handles UTF-8 byte cap. Good defense in depth.

auth.tsx: exchangeSessionId correctly sets authError on failure and login.tsx surfaces it via testID='login-err'; URL fragment is cleaned only after successful exchange (playbook rules 7+8) - verified in code.
seed_data_creation: Tests created a handful of TEST_reg_*, TEST_dup_*, TEST_life_*, e2e_reg_*, e2e_short_* users (all with TEST_/e2e_ prefixes). Safe to leave; low volume.

Endpoints: POST /api/auth/register (201, min 12 chars, max 72 bytes, dup=409), POST /api/auth/login (200, generic 401), token 'gs-*' works on all auth-guarded endpoints, /auth/logout revokes.
